description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order made for the Customs Valuation of Motor Vehicles that shall be in force from 01.03.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the Customs Ordinance and the Customs (Amendment) Act, No. 2 of 2003. It establishes new regulations for customs valuation of motor vehicles, repeals previous notifications, and contains specific legal provisions and compliance requirements. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a government personnel change, but rather focuses on the implementation of customs law and regulatory framework.
